## Key Concepts

LISA: local indicators of spatial association
  identifies: house, predicted value, deviation, neighbors (using row-standardization)
  creates: local Moran's I, local Moran's I can be larger than 1 
  
  everything receives a label, residual = actual - predicted
  high-high: I am under predicted, my neighbors are under predicted - a pocket that the model unveils, likely a missing amenity
  high-low: I am under predicted, my neighbors are over predicted - one house worth more than its block, some unusual about the house
  low-high: I am over predicted, my neighbors are under predicted - one house worth less than its block, some unusual about the house
  low, low: I am over predicted, my neighbors are over predicted - a pocket that the model unveils, likely a missing amenity
